posts.title: Bookmarks Near the End of Books
posts.description: Many years ago, my son would want me to sit with him as he fell asleep every night. Often, it would take him half an hour or more to do so, so I’d be sitting quietly in the dark just doing nothing. I didn’t mind. posts.title: The Archaeologist and the Witness
posts.description: A long time ago, I used to say that there were two missing roles on any software project: the Software Archaeologist and the Project Witness. The Archaeologist would be able to read commit logs, meeting notes, story cards, or any other form of written context to try and piece together what had happened and why. It’d be possible to do this at any stage of a project, even long after it had finished.
